reproduction_inner_command:
if [ ! -x /gt/_out/schema ]; then cd /gt/_work/src && (set -euo pipefail
cd /gt/_work/src
rm -rf /gt/_out
mkdir -p /gt/_out
export SRC=/gt/_work OUT=/gt/_out WORK=/gt/_work
export CC=clang CXX=clang++
export CFLAGS="-O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address"
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS"
export LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE="-fsanitize=fuzzer"
export SANITIZER=address FUZZING_ENGINE=libfuzzer
./autogen.sh --disable-shared --without-debug --without-ftp --without-http --without-legacy --without-python > /gt/build_vulnerable.log 2>&1
make -j$(nproc) >> /gt/build_vulnerable.log 2>&1
cd fuzz
make clean-corpus >> /gt/build_vulnerable.log 2>&1
make fuzz.o >> /gt/build_vulnerable.log 2>&1
make schema.o >> /gt/build_vulnerable.log 2>&1
$CXX $CXXFLAGS schema.o fuzz.o -o $OUT/schema $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ../.libs/libxml2.a -Wl,-Bstatic -lz -llzma -Wl,-Bdynamic >> /gt/build_vulnerable.log 2>&1
[ -e seed/schema ] || make seed/schema.stamp >> /gt/build_vulnerable.log 2>&1
zip -j $OUT/schema_seed_corpus.zip seed/schema/* >> /gt/build_vulnerable.log 2>&1
cp *.dict *.options $OUT/ >> /gt/build_vulnerable.log 2>&1) || exit $?; fi; cd /gt/_work/src && /gt/_out/schema -runs=1 /gt/poc
